reauth_confirm.title: Renew pairing
reauth_confirm.description: The pairing with **{name}** has ended or is no longer valid. Continue to show a new code and pair the app again. Existing entities and history are kept.

retry.title: Pairing did not complete
retry.description: Select Submit to show a new code. If a code is locked without you having entered it wrongly, someone on your network may be interfering; create a new code.

remote_recommended.title: Network access
remote_recommended.description: Pairing came from outside your home network: recommended. Needed if Home Assistant is reached through a domain name, proxy, Nabu Casa or hairpin NAT; otherwise no messages arrive (the app shows 'unconfirmed (empty_body)'). Messages are signed either way.

data.allow_remote: Also allow requests from outside the home network

remote_inherit.title: Network access
remote_inherit.description: Taken over from an existing entry of this integration. Needed if Home Assistant is reached through a domain name, proxy, Nabu Casa or hairpin NAT; otherwise no messages arrive (the app shows 'unconfirmed (empty_body)'). Messages are signed either way.

data.allow_remote: Also allow requests from outside the home network

remote_default.title: Network access
remote_default.description: Pairing came from your home network: usually not needed. Needed if Home Assistant is reached through a domain name, proxy, Nabu Casa or hairpin NAT; otherwise no messages arrive (the app shows 'unconfirmed (empty_body)'). Messages are signed either way.

data.allow_remote: Also allow requests from outside the home network

progress.wait_for_app:
Open iTrend Player on your TV, go to Settings > Home Assistant and enter this address and code:

**Address:** {address}

**Code:** **{code}**

The code is valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once. This window updates by itself as soon as the app has paired.

error.code_expired: The code expired. Please create a new code.
error.code_locked: Code locked after too many wrong attempts. Please create a new code.
error.code_replaced: Another setup window created a new code. Please create a new code here.
error.code_cancelled: The pairing was cancelled. Please create a new code.
error.pairing_blocked: Several codes were locked in a short time. Pairing is paused for about {minutes} minutes.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.setup_failed: The integration could not be started. Check the log.

unpaired_by_app.title: Device ended the pairing
unpaired_by_app.description: {name} ended the pairing from the app. Its key was deleted. Remove the entry, or open it and select Renew pairing to pair the app again.

key_possibly_copied.title: Pairing key possibly copied
key_possibly_copied.description: Messages for {name} arrived with sequence numbers that suggest the same key is used on two devices (for example a restored backup). Remove the entry and pair the TV again.

remote_source.title: Messages arrive from outside the home network
remote_source.description: The pairing of {name} came from a non-local address. If the app reports 'unconfirmed (empty_body)', Home Assistant drops those messages. Open the integration, select Configure and enable 'Also allow requests from outside the home network'.

init.title: Network access
init.description: Normally only messages from your home network are accepted. Enable this if the TV reaches Home Assistant through a domain name, proxy or hairpin NAT (the sender then appears as a public address). Symptom in the app: 'unconfirmed (empty_body)'. This hardly changes security: every message is signed, and sequence numbers and rate limits still apply.

data.allow_remote: Also allow requests from outside the home network
